build_c4_wsrs_dataset: build a C4-WSRS dataset builder that generates medical abbreviation expansion examples from C4 web text
create_word_finder_regex: create a regex pattern that matches any of the provided abbreviation expansion words in text
run_extract_snippets: run extract_snippets to generate variable-length multi-sentence snippets with abbreviation-expansion candidates from C4 documents
run_reverse_substitution: run reverse_substitution to replace medical abbreviation expansions with their abbreviations at a given substitution rate
review_c4wsrs_config: review the C4WSRSConfig class and its parameters for controlling snippet extraction and substitution behavior
